recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. No follow-up is needed unless future Location.mode edits reintroduce modifier labeling or rationale text without a new PA decision.
issue_request: FHIR-13066 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request asking to remove the modifier flag from Location.mode because mode changes use of a Location but is not fundamental to whether the Location resource is valid.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-13066 or GF#13066 was found. The 2017 Zulip review shows the task came from an isModifier review; later FHIR-52045 records that PA could not find the exact ticket or commit that removed Location.mode's isModifier flag between STU3 and R4.
additional_context: FHIR-52045 later found the remaining contradiction: Location.mode had isModifier=false but a comment still said it was labeled as a modifier. PA voted to correct that description, and commit b57689e1ee16b2eb83ef3d27ee6a0b85d74157d8 removed the stale comment. source/fhir.ini actively includes Location in the current build.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current source/location/structuredefinition-Location.xml Location.mode element has no isModifier flag and no modifier rationale comment; Location.status remains the only modifier element in the Location resource.

related_jiras.note: Applied later PA decision removed the stale Location.mode modifier comment and confirms the current non-modifier interpretation.
Companion modifier-reason work explains why modifier rationale text was being added, but it is a separate cross-resource issue.
